**BlastProtectedDrops gives blast protection from crystal, anchor and TNT and it also has a blacklist command to blacklist items from blast protection and it also supports Folia Supported**

# Features
- ✅ Item Blacklist
- ✅ Optimized
- ✅ Supports Folia
- ✅ Easy to Setup

# Setup
1. Download the jar
2. Put it inside your server plugins
3. Restart
4. Then you can use it and configure it as you want.

# Commands
/blastprot add <item> | To Add Blacklist an Item
/blastprot remove | To remove Blacklist from an Item
/blastprot hand | Blacklist Item in your hand
/blastprot list | List all backlisted Items
/blastprot reload | Reloads Config

# Config Example

```
whitelisted-items:
- DIRT
- COBBLESTONE
- STONE
- GRANITE
- DIORITE
- RAW_IRON
- RAW_GOLD
- COAL
- RAW_COPPER
- COBBLED_DEEPSLATE
- LAPIS_LAZULI
- REDSTONE
- WHEAT_SEEDS
```
